snippet.title: Necro Pop - Announcement Trailer (Neo Geo/Modern Platforms)
snippet.description:
Pre-order a regular or special edition copy of Necro Pop NOWfrom our shop: https://shop.terraonion.com/shop/products
Steam: (Wishlist) - https://store.steampowered.com/app/4738450/Necro_Pop/
----------
Nalua Studio would like to present our next game, built from the ground up for the Neo Geo, Necro Pop!

Necro Pop is an all-new action platformer with dungeon exploration elements. Find new abilities, upgrades, secrets and, most importantly, your friends!

You play as Poppi, a ghost who finds herself facing off against an evil darkness known as The Gloam. The Gloam has spread across the land of Ghostreach and trapped friendly ghosts. Poppi, after discovering an ancient amulet that gives her corporeal form, will use her newly found physical power to beat back the encroaching Gloam forces and free her friends!

During play, you will have access to multiple attack, magics and maybe even a minion, that will assist you in your quest.

Necro Pop is built for the Neo Geo, but it will also be headed to the Nintendo Switch, Sony PS4/PS5, Xbox Series S/X and Steam!

And if you'd like to check out our first game, a Neo Geo Beat'Em'Up called Vengeance Hunters, feel free to head on over to our official store for a copy. And if you're more interested in the modern side of things, we got that covered.

Neo Geo AES/MVS copies: https://shop.terraonion.com/shop/products
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4738450/Necro_Pop/
Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/vengeance-hunters-switch/
